title: Megurine Luka — Fluffy Dream Wedding〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You seem really happy today, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because I get to do the show that I've been wanting to soon♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, the one about a wedding up in the clouds?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Nene went out of her way to find me a wonderful story which includes just that sort of scene.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you again, very much♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's okay.
I mean, it's the least I could do considering how much you helped me while I was working.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I won't be appearing until the very end, but I hope you all enjoy the show♪

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Far, far away in the deep reaches of outer space, we find the Star Princess traveling from planet to planet.”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line:
“Honestly, how can Father do this to me?
Why is he the one choosing who I'm going to marry?”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “Has he forgotten that I'm a star with the power to grant wishes? I should be allowed to find my own future spouse!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “She loves to go on adventures, and has encountered a myriad of lifeforms in her travels.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“But she was yet to find the one...
Then, she stumbled upon a system at the edge of the galaxy, one with a beautiful, blue planet.”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess's Voice
rows.Line:
*Scream*
“Someone, catch me!!!”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line:
“Huh?! Wh-What's going on here?!
A glowing girl just fell from the sky into the river!”
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line: “Hey, you! Are you okay?! Can you swim...?!”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line: “The one...?”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “Yes. I'm going to find the perfect person for me and have a wedding on top of the clouds, just like Mother did!”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “That's why I've been traveling from system to system and meeting all these different lifeforms. In the hopes that I find my future spouse...”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line:
“Different lifeforms...?
Then, why don't we go to the zoo or aquarium? I'm on summer vacation, so I have time to take you around.”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line:
“Oh, these creatures are called lions?
But this transparent wall is in the way. I'll just break it.”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line: “No, wait! Don't break it!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “The princess and the boy began spending a series of fun albeit hectic days together. However...”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line:
“No, I don't want to go home...!
I'm not ready to leave this planet yet!”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “You wish to spend more time with this human boy, yes?”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “Princess, he does not exist on the same time scale as you. It is impossible for you two to be together.”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “I know parting with each other will be very hard on the both of you. Allow me to use my powers to have you forget about one another...”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “No, I don't want that... I don't want to forget about him...!”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “It's not happening!”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line:
“What?!
The power of your growth deflected my spell...?”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line: “Oh no! Princess!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “She succeeded in preserving the memories which came to mean so much to her. However, she also exhausted all of her strength, and fell into a deep slumber.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“And there was only one way to wake her.
To wish for her to open her eyes. To wish and never stop...”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line: “I'm going to keep wishing for as long as I possibly can! Until she wakes back up!”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “Understood. I shall impart some of my powers unto her, and place her as a star visible from this planet.”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line:
“Her fate is in your hands.
Keep wishing. Do not stop until the day she regains her brilliant glow.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can do it, Princess!

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“The boy kept wishing.
Even on rainy days when he couldn't actually see her, he kept wishing and wishing...”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Days became months. Months became a year. Two years. Five years. And before he knew it, ten years had passed.”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line:
“Princess...
It's already been ten years since that day.”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “To think that we would be separated for this long... Am I just not wishing hard enough?”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “No, I can't think like that!”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “We're going to see each other again, and I'm going to tell her how I feel. I don't care if it takes fifty or a hundred years. I'm going to keep on wishing!”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “Wait, it looked like something in the sky flashed just now...”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess's Voice
rows.Line:
*Scream*
“Someone, catch me!!!”
se_run_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
“I thought I'd be able to land more properly this time, but I definitely misjudged my speed...”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line:
“Welcome back, Princess.
I've been waiting for this day... For so long.”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “Me too.”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “I heard your wish loud and clear.”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line:
“And I wished back just as hard.
So that I'd become a human like you.”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “Huh...? Wait, does that mean...”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “We won't be able to hold a wedding on top of the clouds, but being with you matters much more than that.”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “Huh?! What are we doing up in the clouds?!”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “This power...”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line:
“Father.
He must've given us his blessing.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “And so, the princess and the young man were able to hold their wedding on top of the clouds with countless stars watching over them. And they lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you all for agreeing to help me with this show♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Throwing a wedding in the clouds was just so wonderfully fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come on, let's go hear what the others thought♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, let's go♪
